risk_note: RV2 (identity plus app.module.ts and risk.module.ts). Stage ⑫ user-side step-up check (BR-ID-08): X-Step-Up-Token verified with the access-token keys and issuer, aud=step_up, uid / app / device / action bound to the access token, expiry by the injected Clock (10003); the jti is reserved in Redis for the token's remaining life, consumed only when the business result is 2xx and code 0, released otherwise; Redis down at check → 50001; idempotency replays, 40901, 20901, 20903 are not checked; registered after ⑤ and before ⑬ through RiskModule's optional beforeRateLimit (risk's own order unchanged without it). A first phone binding (POST /v1/me/phone without a bound phone) passes without a withStepUp scope (round 2). No contract change. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21). Round 3 (after the first landing's CI): stage ⑫ skips calls without an HTTP request scope, exactly as ④a and ⑤ do (frozen B1-02g abandon-route tests write completed records by calling the idempotency service directly); an HTTP request outside withStepUp still answers 10003.
